column7: Previously known as Christian Revival Center (CRC). Due to lack of financial support from the Mother Church, this small church pulled out from the mother church to seek support from the United Church. Currently supported by the United Church. The building currently serves two purposes. From Monday to Friday, Early Childhood Learning uses the building to teach school kids and on Sundays, building is used for worship.
The school operated until mid-2026 when a conflict arose between the two teachers, leading to a cessation of teaching activities. Consequently, student attendance ceased.

The current location of Dea Primary School was formerly the old Dea airstrip. It became unusable due to excessive mud and a short runway, and no other flights landed after it was initially cleared. The original Dea School was established at Taparuraha, located between Dea, Ugunomo, and Siribu villages. When the airstrip became non-operational, the school was relocated to the airstrip site as it needed an area accessible to the main road.
The community left this area to settle next to the Main Highway (now the current Serefuna village) Population was also expanding and the community needed a bigger area to resettle there.
